name: Media & Spotify control
description: Native OS media control (play/pause/next/previous/volume/mute) plus current-track observation. Uses the Windows media-key interface before any screen automation.

capabilities.name: play
capabilities.verification: media session state observed after the key press

capabilities.name: pause
capabilities.verification: media session state observed after the key press

capabilities.name: previous
capabilities.description: Go back to the previous track

capabilities.name: current_track
capabilities.description: Report the track that is currently playing
capabilities.verification: observed from the media application window

capabilities.name: volume_up
capabilities.description: Raise the system volume one step

capabilities.name: volume_down
capabilities.description: Lower the system volume one step

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.description: Report what media GENIE can currently observe

author: GENIE
